name: Maw, Horned
body:
Horned Maw
CR 4

XP 1,200
N Medium animal
Init +0; Senses low-light vision; Perception +6

DEFENSE

AC 17, touch 11, flat-footed 16 (+1 Dex, +6 natural)
hp 37 (5d8+15)
Fort +7, Ref +5, Will +2 (+4 vs. disease and poison)

OFFENSE

Speed 30 ft.
Melee bite +8 (2d6+6+1d4 acid) or claw +7 (1d4+4) or gore +7 (1d8+4)
Special Attacks powerful charge (2d8+6)
Space 5 ft.; Reach 5 ft.

STATISTICS

STR 18, Dex 12, Con 16, Int 1, Wis 12, Cha 2
Base Attack +3; CMB +7, CMD 18
Feats Improved Natural Weapon (bite), Run, Weapon Focus (bite)
Skills Acrobatics +4, Perception +6, Survival +6

ECOLOGY

Environment deserts or plains
Organization solitary or feasting group (2-5)
Treasure none

This very odd reptile is mostly a mouth and has only two legs. It sports two elephantine tusks on either side of its mouth.

Horned maws are very close cousin to the common maw but are different in that they are more agile and sport tusks which are used for defense and in mating disputes among females. They are also much more discerning in what they eat so they are much less likely to carry disease.
